name: kickoff
description: Kick off a new project with one standard questionnaire: questions branch on earlier answers, each offers pre-defined options and a default, answers are recorded in the project, and a charter (overview, goal, scope, numbered decisions with their reasons, open questions) is generated from them. A machine-wide dev-port registry, shared by every Claude account on the Mac and aware of ports already published in compose files, hands each project a free port. Runtime-free (bash + awk).
